summary: Phase AD.8 finalisation E2E — 22 pytest tests + Playwright UI validation. 21/22 backend tests PASS. 1 backend integration failure: /api/wallet/me points_balance reads legacy users.bigcoin_balance, NOT the PointsService ledger balance — so daily-code claim points are NOT reflected in wallet/me even though the ledger is credited correctly. Frontend all correct: DailyCodeWidget renders in both ?design=legacy and ?design=radiolife, shows CLAIMED TODAY / 1-day streak / 1x multiplier state after prior claim (data-testid=daily-code-widget-already), Auction Insights page renders 2 rows + 2 boost buttons, clicking boost yields data-testid=auction-insights-boost-result-* successfully.

critical.issue: points_balance is read from users.bigcoin_balance (legacy field), but PointsService.award (Phase F-2 ledger flip, BIGCOIN_LEGACY_DUAL_WRITE=0) NO LONGER mirrors to bigcoin_balance. Result: user's daily-code claim is credited in points_ledger (balance_after=1124) but wallet/me returns stale 4100. The user's Phase-AD.8 spec explicitly requires 'PointsService balance must increase by points_awarded — verify via GET /api/wallet/me points_balance' — this is broken. Fix: wallet_v2_service.py:166-172 should call PointsService(db).get_balance(user_id) instead of reading users.bigcoin_balance. Or re-enable dual-write for daily_code_claim.

action_items: Fix wallet_v2_service.py:166-172 — replace users.bigcoin_balance read with PointsService.get_balance() so wallet/me reflects ledger truth. Alternatively, re-mirror daily_code_claim awards to users.bigcoin_balance.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet_v2_service.py points_balance sourcing is inconsistent with Phase F-2 ledger flip — it still reads the legacy mirror field. Any earn path that doesn't dual-write (like daily_code_claim) will be invisible in the wallet UI.

daily_code_service.claim() swallows PointsService.award exceptions with warning-only logging (line 332-333) — a hard failure to credit points would go unnoticed by the client (they see ok:true + points_awarded but no balance change). Consider surfacing this as a 500 or returning a credit_error field.

auction_insights_service.boost_campaign_bid — banner path (line 155) uses a confusing bool-and-max expression `(camp.get('per_zone_cpm_cents') or {}).values() and max(...) or 0` which is correct but fragile; refactor to `max(zones.values(), default=0)`.
daily_code service correctly enforces all streak ladder rungs including 2x cap and yesterday-check reset — verified via multi-day backdated seed tests.

The only failure is the wallet/me integration point which relies on the deprecated users.bigcoin_balance mirror. UI has daily-code-widget-{anon,loading,success,already,widget} testids and auction-insights-page/-row-{i}/-boost-{event_id}/-boost-result-{event_id} testids — all working. Banner zone slot for station_detail was NOT present in DOM during test (no active banner campaign → renders null); source-level DOM order (LiveRadioStation.jsx L409-412) is confirmed correct.
rca of the issue: wallet_v2_service.py line 170 reads points_balance = users.bigcoin_balance. Phase F-2 ledger flip (services/points_service.py line 259-268) disabled the default legacy mirror to users.bigcoin_balance. Env BIGCOIN_LEGACY_DUAL_WRITE=0. Therefore new earn paths (including daily_code_claim) update points_ledger.balance_after but not the legacy field. Mitigation: switch wallet_v2_service to call PointsService.get_balance(user_id) OR set BIGCOIN_LEGACY_DUAL_WRITE=1 (rollback escape hatch). Repro: (1) DELETE existing claims for demo, (2) POST /api/daily-code/claim with today's code, (3) GET /api/wallet/me — points_balance UNCHANGED from pre-claim value, yet points_ledger has new row with delta=50 and balance_after incremented.
